title: Timeless 30A
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘Timeless 30A’, a luxury 9-bed, 10 full & 2 half-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 28 guests, this home offers a Private Pool with Hot Tub, Summer Kitchen, Theater & Golf Cart. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Walking distance to the beach | Approximately 400 Feet - Resort style Private Pool & Spa (Heating available for an additional $80 per day during the months of Oct 31-May 1) - Outdoor Fireplace + Seating - Lake Front with Lake Access - Summer Kitchen with Grilling Station - Media Room & Game Room with Bar - 6 Adult Bikes Included - 6 seater Golf Cart included DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Timeless 30A, a brand-new, professionally designed vacation retreat that redefines luxury on the stunning 30A coastline. Offering effortless beach access and showcasing exquisite craftsmanship, this home combines contemporary elegance with thoughtful functionality, creating the ultimate escape for families and groups. On the first floor, you’ll find three beautifully appointed king guest suites with spa-like ensuite bathrooms, as well as a charming bunk room with its own ensuite bath—perfect for younger guests. The entertainment-focused game room, complete with a television and pool table, opens directly to the pool deck, where relaxation awaits. A fully equipped bar area with a sink, fridge, ice machine, and convection microwave ensures refreshments are always at hand. This level also features a laundry room with a front-load washer and dryer, folding area, and sink, along with a convenient half bath and an elevator providing easy access to every floor. The second floor is the heart of the home, designed for gathering and entertaining. A chef’s dream kitchen boasts a 6-burner Wolf stove with double ovens, an oversized refrigerator, and a convection microwave, all complemented by a spacious island that seats seven. A butler’s pantry with a dishwasher, sink, and wine cooler enhances the culinary experience. The dining room comfortably seats ten, while the elegant living room, complete with a fireplace, invites relaxation. Three luxurious king suites with ensuite baths are found on this floor, including a serene primary king suite, ensuring every guest enjoys their own private retreat. The third floor offers a mix of entertainment and tranquility. The grand primary bedroom features a private seating area, balcony, and spa-inspired ensuite bathroom, while a king guest suite with a balcony and a shared bathroom provides additional comfort. A whimsical bunk room with an arcade machine and ensuite bath adds a playful touch, and the media room, complete with a foosball table and balcony, offers endless entertainment. A convenient wet bar with a sink and mini-fridge and a stackable washer and dryer round out this level. Step outside to your private outdoor oasis, where a sparkling pool and spa await, surrounded by seven loungers and umbrellas for ultimate relaxation. A cozy firepit with a seating area provides the perfect spot for evening gatherings, while outdoor dining spaces and a fully equipped summer kitchen on the second-floor balcony invite alfresco meals. The property also features a private dock with direct access to Allen Lake, perfect for tranquil paddleboard sessions and connecting with nature. Additionally, this prime location is just a short walk to the famous Stinky’s Fish Camp, where you can savor coastal Cajun-inspired cuisine in a laid-back atmosphere. Timeless 30A is more than a vacation rental; it’s a sanctuary for creating cherished memories. Whether you’re lounging by the pool, enjoying gourmet meals, paddleboarding on Allen Lake, or dining at a local favorite, every detail has been carefully curated to make your stay unforgettable. Indulge in the pinnacle of luxury and book your escape to Timeless 30A today.
